name: The Manor
source:
After a car accident, you find yourself in an unknown area. Searching for help, you find an old manor which seems to be vacant. But is there really no one in this old house? What family secret can be found in the different rooms?

Which path you take is yours to decide. But beware, one wrong move can lead to death!

[From [url=https://lolapiaoliang.itch.io/the-manor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场车祸后，你发现自己身处一个未知的区域。在寻找帮助时，你发现了一座似乎空置的古老庄园。但这老房子里真的没有人吗？不同的房间里能发现什么家庭秘密？

你走哪条路是你自己决定的。但要小心，一个错误的举动可能会导致死亡！

[来自[url=https://lolapiaoliang.itch.io/the-manor]itch.io[/url]]
